lines.text: Jesus went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and taught on the Sabbath with authority.
In the synagogue, Jesus rebuked a demon and it came out of the man, hurting him badly.
Jesus went to the home of Simon, rebuked the fever of his mother-in-law, and she served them.
At sunset, Jesus laid His hands on each sick person, and the demons knew He was the Baptist.
At daybreak Jesus went to a solitary place, then said He must preach to other towns because He was sent.
